name: Adjudicated HTLC (griefing-resistant hash-time-lock)
description: Extends the atomic-swap HTLC with an adjudication path that defeats the griefing / free-option attack — where a counterparty withholds the preimage to hold funds hostage until the timeout. When a swap stalls, either party can `dispute`, and a trusted high-reputation adjudicator resolves it before timeout by signing a ruling (BN254 Schnorr, schnorr_verify) that releases to the recipient or refunds the sender. Exercises both poseidon (hash-lock) and schnorr_verify (adjudicator authority).

events.name: claim
events.description: Reveal the correct preimage; poseidon([secret]) === hashLock

events.name: claim (wrong preimage)
events.description: Wrong secret; poseidon mismatch denies the claim

events.name: dispute
events.description: Flag the swap as stalled/griefed; opens it for adjudication

testFlows.name: Honest claim — correct preimage opens the lock
testFlows.description: The cooperative path is unchanged: reveal the true preimage and the fiber goes LOCKED -> CLAIMED.

testFlows.name: Rejected — wrong preimage cannot claim
testFlows.description: poseidon([secret]) != hashLock, the guard denies the claim, the fiber stays at LOCKED.

testFlows.name: Griefing resolved — dispute, then the adjudicator releases
testFlows.description: The anti-griefing path: a stalled swap is disputed (LOCKED -> DISPUTED), then the trusted adjudicator's valid Schnorr RELEASE ruling is verified (schnorr_verify against the pinned adjudicatorPubKey) and the funds are released to the recipient (DISPUTED -> CLAIMED) — without waiting for the timeout.

testFlows.name: Rejected — a forged ruling cannot resolve
testFlows.description: Security of the adjudication path: after a dispute, a TAMPERED ruling fails schnorr_verify, so no one can steal the funds by faking the adjudicator — the fiber stays at DISPUTED.
